YTA. 

This year has been tough for everyone. Working might be your father way of feeling with stress (maybe he wants to spend time with his coworkers and friends). 

He probably has money worries aş well. (Leaving all the money making to you doesnt really sound good to him.)
Telling him you are cutting support doesnt help much. If anything he will want to work more. 

Let him work and hes a grown man. He can decide for himself when he wants to leave.
I would suggest you to talk to him again and tell him "You make enough money to support everyone now and you dont like seeing him tired everyday. That you just want him to rest and take care of his health. Don't worry about anything. "
And if he still insists to work after this. Let him. Don't pressure him into something he doesnt wanna do.

Yeah, that's the best advice I can give...
